newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Fernandez soft on tax dodgers - Cavallo.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Fernandez soft on tax dodgers - Cavallo.

text.p: Former Argentine Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo Tuesday accused his successor Roque Fernandez of not cracking down hard enough on tax dodgers and of caving in to pressures from other cabinet members.
"He is surrendering key areas of the economy ministry, either simply to make his own life easier or under pressure from other ministers," Cavallo told a local radio station.

Fernandez's failure to crack down on tax evaders more aggressively may force the government to take up more debt to make up for lost revenues, charged Cavallo, who was sacked last July by President Carlos Menem after six years in the cabinet.

"I am somewhat worried by these things because in the long run they turn into debts that must be paid, which may lead to a big bond or debt paper issue," said Cavallo, the architect or Argentina's return to currency stability and economic growth after years of stagnation and hyperinflation.

The former minister, who is not a member of the ruling Peronist Party, is planning to run for Congress in October's polls, probably joining forces with other independents or members of smaller parties.
